regime_read: The clearest measured convergence is in semiconductors and AI infrastructure, led by MU, with more mixed but still coherent signals in PLTR, MRK, and MSFT. With no completed track-record observations, conviction remains capped at medium and sentiment-heavy clusters receive less weight.
regime_read_zh: 当前最清晰的多源信号集中在半导体与AI基础设施，MU居首；PLTR、MRK和MSFT也呈现较一致但更复杂的信号。由于尚无已完成评分的历史判断，置信度最高仅为中等，并对情绪驱动型信号降低权重。

theses.thesis: MU has the broadest actionable alignment: buying by four congressional members, strongly positive insider purchase activity, accelerating federal grants, and a large patent cluster point in the same direction [congress_cluster] [insider_mspr] [gov_grant_accel] [patent_cluster]. Ro Khanna's disclosed affiliation adds policy-network context [actor:Ro Khanna]. The stock is not extended and has lagged SPY over 60 days, so the signal is not dependent on chasing recent relative strength.
theses.thesis_zh: MU呈现最广泛且可执行的信号共振：四名国会议员的净买入、明显积极的内部人买入活动、加速的联邦拨款以及较大的专利集群均指向同一方向 [congress_cluster] [insider_mspr] [gov_grant_accel] [patent_cluster]。Ro Khanna披露的关联关系提供了政策网络背景 [actor:Ro Khanna]。该股并未处于过度延伸状态，且过去60日相对SPY落后，因此无需追逐近期相对强势。
second_order: Semiconductor-memory equipment: stronger memory investment would flow through to fabrication and packaging suppliers
AI-server supply chain: improving memory demand would support systems requiring high-bandwidth memory
theses.dissent: The CNBC and Stocktwits components are sentiment channels rather than fundamental confirmation, while recent relative underperformance may reflect genuine weakness in the memory cycle.

falsifier.text: Federal-grant momentum reverses and subsequent insider or congressional disclosures no longer show net buying while memory-related operating demand weakens.

theses.clamped: lean 'overweight' → 'underweight' (deterministic witness); conviction 'medium' → 'low' (deterministic ceiling); action 'ACCUMULATE' → 'AVOID' (deterministic ceiling)

theses.thesis: PLTR combines current federal-contract activity and acceleration with a uniformly bullish analyst-upgrade cluster and disclosed relationships to Marjorie Taylor Greene and Cathie Wood [gov_contract] [analyst_upgrade_cluster] [actor:Marjorie Taylor Greene] [actor:Cathie Wood]. However, retail and Stocktwits enthusiasm are likely correlated rather than independent, and the Trump-linked transaction signal is on the sell side [retail_buzz] [stocktwits_bull] [trump], making WATCH more appropriate than immediate accumulation.
theses.thesis_zh: PLTR同时具备近期联邦合同活动及加速、集中偏多的分析师上调信号，以及与Marjorie Taylor Greene和Cathie Wood的披露关系 [gov_contract] [analyst_upgrade_cluster] [actor:Marjorie Taylor Greene] [actor:Cathie Wood]。不过，散户热度与Stocktwits情绪可能高度相关，并非真正独立信号，而且特朗普关联交易信号为卖出方向 [retail_buzz] [stocktwits_bull] [trump]，因此更适合观察而非立即吸纳。
second_order: Government AI software: continued PLTR contract momentum would imply broader agency adoption of operational AI
Defense-cloud infrastructure: larger deployments would require secure compute, storage, and integration capacity
theses.dissent: The politician-linked sell signal directly conflicts with the bullish cluster, while two of the six channels are overlapping retail sentiment measures.

falsifier.text: Federal-contract acceleration turns negative and disclosed institutional or political positioning shifts toward net selling.

theses.thesis: MRK's alignment is event-driven rather than sentiment-driven: multiple Phase 3 starts, an FDA label-expansion signal, substantial lobbying activity, and a Trump-linked buy signal form a coherent regulatory and pipeline cluster [clinical_phase3_start] [fda_label_expansion] [lobbying] [trump]. The healthcare bills are only introduced and do not establish a company-specific catalyst, so they add sector context rather than thesis confirmation [bill:HR10087]. With relative strength already elevated but below the extended threshold, WATCH preserves entry discipline.
theses.thesis_zh: MRK的信号共振主要由事件驱动，而非情绪驱动：多项三期临床启动、FDA标签扩展信号、较高的游说活动以及特朗普关联买入信号，共同构成较一致的监管与研发管线组合 [clinical_phase3_start] [fda_label_expansion] [lobbying] [trump]。相关医疗法案仍仅处于提出阶段，不能构成公司特定催化剂，只能提供行业背景 [bill:HR10087]。其相对强势已经较高但尚未达到过度延伸标准，因此以观察维持入场纪律。
second_order: Clinical-research services: a larger late-stage trial portfolio increases demand for trial execution and data services
Oncology diagnostics: broader cancer treatment and care planning can raise companion-testing and monitoring demand
theses.dissent: Four clinical halts are a material counter-signal and could outweigh the apparent breadth of Phase 3 activity if they affect important programs.

falsifier.text: Additional material clinical halts occur or the anticipated label-expansion pathway is delayed or rejected.

theses.thesis: MSFT shows product and developer adoption alongside innovation activity: strong app demand, substantial model-download activity, GitHub momentum, and a large patent cluster provide several operating-adjacent signals [app_demand] [github_momentum] [patent_cluster]. The Sam Altman partnership relationship supports the AI-platform interpretation, while Bill Ackman's disclosed affiliation adds a smart-money network signal [actor:Sam Altman] [actor:Bill Ackman]. The signals are coherent but lack a direct contracting, insider-buying, or 13F-add channel, keeping conviction low.
theses.thesis_zh: MSFT同时呈现产品和开发者采用度以及创新活动：较强的应用需求、可观的模型下载量、GitHub动能和大型专利集群，构成多项接近经营层面的信号 [app_demand] [github_momentum] [patent_cluster]。与Sam Altman的合作关系支持AI平台逻辑，Bill Ackman披露的关联则提供聪明资金网络信号 [actor:Sam Altman] [actor:Bill Ackman]。这些信号方向一致，但缺少直接的合同、内部人买入或13F增持渠道，因此置信度保持较低。
second_order: Data-center power and cooling: sustained cloud and AI usage requires additional electrical and thermal capacity
Enterprise software integrators: broader AI-platform adoption increases implementation and migration work
theses.dissent: App reviews, downloads, and GitHub activity may overlap around the same popularity effect and may not translate into incremental revenue or margins.

falsifier.text: Developer and app-demand momentum declines together without corresponding growth in commercial AI adoption.
